id: from-stage-combined-resume
name: Combined --resume --from-stage test fixture (#1805)
extends: simple
defaults:
  strategy: fanout

# Three-stage pipeline for DSFSTG-3: a leaf (intake) before the --from-stage
# target, a cycle (cyc) as the target, and a leaf (verify) after the target.
# Tests that in combined --resume --from-stage <cyc> mode, stages after <cyc>
# (including verify, which may be marked complete in interrupted state) are
# still dispatched after the skip_until_stage guard clears at <cyc>.
stages:
  - id: intake
    gate: auto
    roles: [intake]
  - id: cyc
    type: cycle
    stages: [cycled]
    until:
      stage: cycled
      field: verdict
      op: eq
      value: pass
    max_iterations: 1
    on_max: continue
  - id: verify
    gate: auto

stage_definitions:
  cycled:
    roles: [builder]
